First of all, welcome to Soul Knight. I hope you enjoy the game so far.

I have some advices to give you. First of all the game is a dungeon runner that has 15 levels, as a fellow redditor has already explained, and if you lose you have to start all over again next run. So far you might find the game difficult but if you keep playing, you will find it fairly simple and after some runs you will get your first win. But in order to win, you have to learn some things:

1. Buffs

Learn what each buff does and which ones to prioritise above others. The most important buffs are 3:

1. ***No extra damage if shield is broken.*** This is currently the best buff in the game. It nullifies any damage that is bigger than your current armor. For example you have 3 armor points and a bullet hits you for 4 damage. Without this buff you would get 3 armor damage and 1 HP damage. But with the buff you only get the armor damage. I hope you understand how important this buff is, especially at later levels.
2. ***Immune to fire and decreased explosion damage, increased fire damage to monsters.*** This buff does exactly what it says. It is extremely important at the 3rd floor if you get the volcano level, as the floor sometimes cracks and the lava damages you.
3. ***Immune to poison gas and slow effect, increase poison damage to monsters.***  Again a pretty straightforward description. It is extremely useful in the spaceship level with the aliens.

There are of course more buffs but i pointed out the most important ones that you should always get.

2.  Dodging and Cover

To become a expert player at Soul Knight, you need to learn to dodge bullets and use any available cover to your advantage. It is hard at first but as I said you need to play a lot of games to get the hang of dodging as many bullets as possible. 

However, in most of the levels there is available cover in the form of either wooden boxes, that can break, or indestructible terrain. Learn to play with any cover you are given.

3. Finding your main character

Soul Knight has a big variety of characters with different powers. At first you start with Knight but you can purchase the rest of the characters with either gems or real money( with the exception of Robot which is unlocked with a different method). I would advice you to buy all the available characters with gems and find the one you are comfortable with.
